requirements_summary: Enterprise search for legal docs: indexing target ~200M documents (mixed text + attachments). Primary retrieval = embeddings (256d) with hybrid BM25 fallback and cross-encoder rerank on top-k. P95 end-to-end latency target <150ms for single-shot search across dedicated traffic; throughput goal 1k qps burst, steady 250 qps. Cost sensitivity medium-high: wants unit economics estimate (cost/query) for hosted vs dedicated. Connector must support incremental streaming upserts, transactional deletes, backfill tooling, schema mapping for metadata facets, similarity metric parity (cosine), and hybrid search hooks (BM25+ANN). Expect integration with current MGMT system (Kafka changefeed) and SSO/SAML for admin console. Must provide audit logs, encryption at rest with customer-managed KMS, and EU data residency options.
